name: Exp_ColorJJRSX_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJJRSX indicator, a colored version of the JJRSX (Jurik RSX) momentum oscillator. It enters long positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change to upward) and short positions when it turns bearish, with time filtering and plus features for enhanced trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJJRSX指标进行交易，JJRSX是Jurik RSX动量振荡器的彩色版本。当指标转为看涨颜色时做多，转为看跌颜色时做空，并具有时间过滤和增强交易管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ColorJJRSX动量振荡器的颜色变化作为交易信号。入场条件为：当JJRSX指标颜色从下跌转为上涨时开多仓，从上涨转为下跌时开空仓，属于典型的动量反转交易策略。出场条件依赖于指标颜色的再次反转或固定止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数配置。该EA还加入了时间过滤功能，允许用户限制交易时段，避免在不利时段开仓。Plus版本可能增加了移动止损、追踪止损等增强功能，提升了交易管理的灵活性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses color changes of the ColorJJRSX momentum oscillator as trading signals. Entry conditions: open long when the JJRSX indicator color changes from bearish to bullish, and open short when it changes from bullish to bearish, representing a typical momentum reversal trading approach. Exit conditions rely on the indicator color reversing again or on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation tied to account equity. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though the actual risk control effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. The EA also includes a time filter feature, allowing users to restrict trading to specific sessions and avoid opening positions during unfavorable periods. The Plus version likely adds enhanced features such as trailing stops, improving trade management flexibility.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA的魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 使用Jurik RSX指标，该指标相比传统RSI更加平滑且延迟更低，信号质量较好
内置时间过滤功能，可以避开低流动性或高波动的非理想交易时段
Plus版本提供增强的订单管理功能，如追踪止损，有助于保护利润
可视化颜色变化使信号判断直观明确，减少主观判断
pros_en: Uses the Jurik RSX indicator which is smoother and has less lag than traditional RSI, providing better signal quality
Built-in time filter allows avoiding low liquidity or high volatility unfavorable trading sessions
The Plus version offers enhanced order management features like trailing stops to help protect profits
Visual color changes make signal interpretation intuitive and reduce subjective judgment errors
cons: 作为动量反转策略，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损止盈为0，如果用户不手动设置则完全没有风险保护，存在极大资金风险
缺乏仓位加仓或减仓的动态调整机制，无法根据市场波动性自适应调整
单一指标依赖容易在市场结构变化时失效，缺乏多维度确认
cons_en: As a momentum reversal strategy, it is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Default stop-loss and take-profit are 0, meaning no risk protection if users don't manually configure them, posing extreme capital risk
Lacks dynamic position sizing adjustment mechanism, unable to adapt to changing market volatility
Single indicator dependency makes it vulnerable when market structure changes, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，例如要求高周期趋势方向与信号一致才开仓，过滤低质量信号
添加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，使风险管理适应市场波动性变化
引入交易次数限制和最大连续亏损限制，防止极端行情下的过度交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher timeframe trend alignment before entry to filter low-quality signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation so risk management adapts to market volatility changes
Introduce trade frequency limits and maximum consecutive loss limits to prevent over-trading during extreme market conditions

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，未配置时完全没有风险保护，可能导致单笔大额亏损
动量反转策略在趋势行情中可能逆势开仓，缺乏趋势过滤机制
缺乏最大持仓限制和资金回撤保护，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are 0, providing no risk protection when unconfigured, potentially leading to large single-trade losses
Momentum reversal strategy may open counter-trend positions during trending markets, lacking trend filter mechanism
No maximum position limit or drawdown protection, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
